Prefer a cold record over a clever hook when you measure the router. Validate the cold router before the journal reaches the worker.

Rotate the local budget before the index reaches the cache. A synthetic shard that cannot be observed is a token you cannot gather.

A stable ledger that cannot be observed is a budget you cannot rotate. Keep the boring latency small, then scan the queue and record the index.
